---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---




This page compares the production budget for films with its worldwide revenue. @fig-budget-revenue plots budget on the x-axis and revenue on the y-axis.

::: {#64802868 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (millions)")
plt.ylabel("Global revenue (millions)")
plt.show()
```
